apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Automatically charged once per Actor run by Apify platform (covers first 5 seconds of compute). Never charged manually in code.

domain-audited.eventDescription: Charged per successfully audited public domain across AI crawlers/llms.txt/JSON-LD, HTTP security headers, TLS certificate, DNS SPF/DMARC/CAA, and security.txt. Invalid, SSRF-blocked, or unreachable domains incur $0.
